name: QRC Generate
description: Generate a sequence from a trained QRC model, reused by reference (train once, generate many).

output_files.name: state
output_files.description: Updated reservoir state; chain into a further qrc-gen-v2 call via input_files.state.

initial_events.description: Warm up the reservoir on these events before generating, instead of the whole vocabulary (the default for a fresh model). Tokens must belong to the model's vocabulary. Ignored when continuing from a `state` that is itself a prior qrc-gen-v1 output, unless given explicitly to deliberately re-seed the trajectory.
initial_events.title: Initial Events

random_seed.description: RNG seed for this call's own generation randomness (softmax sampling) — applied after the model is loaded, not the seed the QRC was trained with (that one is always reused exactly, to reconstruct the reservoir faithfully). None = keep whatever RNG state the model already has (deterministic given the same inputs); give a value to force a specific, reproducible sampling trajectory.
random_seed.title: Random Seed

shots.description: Measurement shots during generation (backend.shots). None = keep whatever shots the model was trained (or last generated) with.
shots.title: Shots

variation.description: Sampling temperature: low = deterministic/repetitive, high = random
variation.title: Variation

vocabulary.description: Relabel the model's output space: the trained reservoir/readout only depend on vocabulary *size*, not identity, so any vocabulary with the same number of distinct tokens as the model's own can be swapped in — generation then emits from this vocabulary instead. A different size raises `incompatible_model` (readout shape mismatch).
vocabulary.title: Vocabulary

description_md:
qrc-gen-v1 — generate a sequence from a trained QRC model.

The `state` input is qrc-train-v1's named binary output (or a prior qrc-gen-v1 call's own
`state` output) — a plain dict of JSON-safe values (see `_to_native`) carrying `version`, the
vocabulary, the training parameters, and the trained readout/reservoir weights. Accepted either
already as that dict (composing engines directly in Python, e.g. in a notebook) or as
JSON-encoded bytes/str (a file upload or `job:<id>/state` named-output reference — see
features-0.6.md). Rebuilds the QRCGenerator the same way qrc-train-v1 does: load this engine's
own copy of config.yaml and apply the state's training parameters over it — then restores the
trained readout and reservoir memory, and generates a new sequence.

code_samples.source:
import requests
# Reuse a trained model's state by reference — no re-upload, no re-training.
r = requests.post(
    "https://api.mothquantum.com/v1/generation/qrc-gen-v2/process",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_KEY"},
    data={"length": 10, "state": "job:TRAIN_JOB_ID/state"},
)
print(r.json()["job_id"])

curl -X POST https://api.mothquantum.com/v1/generation/qrc-gen-v2/process \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
  -F length=10 \
  -F state=job:TRAIN_JOB_ID/state
